answer: An optical attestation protocol curbs Sybil attacks by measuring laser speckle patterns scattered through a photonic crystal token bonded to each agent. Because microscopic lattice flaws cannot be cloned or simulated in software, an attacker must provision discrete physical tokens and optical sensors per identity. However, matching confidence drops to an operational nadir if an ambient zephyr perturbs the beam path, and gradual physical degradation of the medium causes false rejections.
